question: Which syllables and goddess are to be placed at the end of the kṣetra word?
premises: The syllables maṃ and yaṃ are specified.
The placement is at the end of the word kṣetra.
Kālarātrī is included following the previous pattern.
inference: One should place maṃ and yaṃ with Kālarātrī at the end of the kṣetra word as before.
